title: China's Best Morning Costs Almost Nothing (Skip the Ticket Line) | China Travel Expert
description:
Hot take: in China, some of the best mornings barely cost a thing — and most tourists walk right past them.

While the famous scenic areas charge premium tickets, thousands of working temples let you in for a yuan or nothing at all, and hand you incense for free at the gate. A Guangzhou temple charges ¥1 and gives three free joss sticks; Shanghai's City God Temple and Beijing's Lama Temple give incense free; Hangzhou's Lingyin Temple has been free to enter since December 2025. Go early and you'll see monks and locals actually worshipping — not a tour queue. This is my opinion on where a first morning is best spent; the fees are verified.

🧭 Expert Tip: Visit 7-9am — the most auspicious hours, and when locals really show up. Take incense with your right hand, bow, and never point the lit end at people.

花小钱，甚至不花钱——清晨的中国寺庙，才是被游客错过的宝藏。
